AI facial recognition vans at Jantar Mantar raise Aadhaar, privacy questions
results.description: Delhi Police’s AI-powered facial recognition vehicles deployed at Jantar Mantar have sparked a privacy debate after viral videos claimed protesters were being identified in real time. Authorities say the system only matches faces against a criminal database, while there is no official evidence that it is linked to Aadhaar.
